lines.en: Beneath the village lieth the Well. For a thousand years, guardians have descended to keep it sealed. Not one hath returned.
lines.zh: 村子底下有一口井。一千年來，守門人一個接一個下去封住它，沒有人回來過。

lines.en: Now the dead climb forth from the cellars — and the Order hath sent one more.
lines.zh: 如今死者從地窖裡爬出來，騎士團又派了一個人下去。

lines.en: Below the cellars, a captain keepeth still his last command, three hundred winters old: let none pass below.
lines.zh: 地窖底下，一位隊長還守著三百年前的最後一道命令：不准任何人往下走。

lines.en: His men slumber in the tombs about him. They shall rise when he calleth.
lines.zh: 他的部下睡在周圍的墓穴裡，他一喊，他們就會醒來。

lines.en: Beyond the tombs, the bells yet toll in the sanctum where once the Well was held shut by prayer.
lines.zh: 墓穴之後，聖堂的鐘還在響。這口井曾經靠祈禱封住。

lines.en: Its priest prayeth no more. Now he listeneth — to a voice that riseth from beneath his altar.
lines.zh: 那裡的神官已經不再祈禱。他在聽，聽一個從祭壇底下傳上來的聲音。

lines.en: Beneath the sanctum lie the mines of an elder kingdom. They delved for a fire that might be forged into power — the very cores she beareth were born of it.
lines.zh: 聖堂底下，是一個更古老王國的礦坑。他們挖的是能鍛成力量的火，她身上的熔核就是從這裡來的。

lines.en: They delved too deep. Something within the mountain burneth still — and it walketh.
lines.zh: 他們挖得太深了。山裡有個東西還在燒，而且會走。

lines.en: Past the mines standeth the fortress of the Order — her Order. Ten winters past, her master went down to seal the Well anew, and came never back.
lines.zh: 礦坑之後，是騎士團的要塞，她的騎士團。十年前，師父下去重新封井，再也沒有回來。

lines.en: One yet holdeth the fortress gate, with a blade that burneth, freezeth and thundereth — even as he taught her.
lines.zh: 如今有人守在要塞門口，劍會燃燒、會結冰、會打雷，就像他當年教她的那樣。

lines.en: Below the fortress, the passages twist and change, as though something yet weaveth them.
lines.zh: 要塞之下，通道會扭曲、會改變，像是有什麼東西還在編織它們。

lines.en: Here the eldest kingdom met its end. Its queen swore to wait for one who walked into the dark — and she waiteth still.
lines.zh: 最古老的王國在這裡結束。它的女王發誓要等一個走進黑暗的人，她到現在還在等。

lines.en: At the very bottom, a temple was raised upon the wound itself. Its lord beareth wings, and nameth himself master of the abyss.
lines.zh: 最底下，有人在傷口正上方蓋了一座神殿。神殿的主人長著翅膀，自稱深淵的主宰。

lines.en: Many have reached his steps. Each of them believed him to be the end.
lines.zh: 很多人走到過他的階梯前，每個人都以為他就是盡頭。

lines.en: The lord was but a hand. Beneath the temple, the thing that grew it hath watched her, learning every stroke she maketh.
lines.zh: 魔王只是一隻手。神殿底下，長出那隻手的東西一直在看著她，學她的每一招。

lines.en: The way back is no more. It shall show her the guardians it hath swallowed, one by one — and at the very bottom, it beareth Aislinn's sword and shield.
lines.zh: 回頭的路已經沒了。牠會把吞下的守門人一個一個放出來給她看，而在最底下，牠拿著艾希琳的劍與盾。

lines.en: One by one, the eyes did close. Aislinn and the queen rose together, hand in hand, as they had parted a thousand years before.
lines.zh: 眼睛一顆一顆闔上。艾希琳和女王一起升起，手牽著手，就像一千年前分開時那樣。

lines.en: For the first time in a thousand years, light fell to the bottom of the Well. She climbed alone, past every place where a guardian had fallen.
lines.zh: 一千年來，第一次有光照到井底。她獨自往上爬，經過每一位守門人倒下的地方。

lines.en: The village she returned to lay half in ruin. The Order was but an empty hall. None had waited for her.
lines.zh: 她回到的村子已經半毀。騎士團只剩一座空蕩的大廳，沒有人在等她回來。

lines.en: When the kingdom heard the thing below was dead, it did not mourn. It sent miners — to dig the cores that none now guarded.
lines.zh: 王國聽說井底的東西死了，沒有哀悼，而是派了礦工下去，挖那些不再有人看守的熔核。

lines.en: She set Aislinn's sword and shield at the mouth of the Well, and stayed. No seal. No sacrifice. A keeper — living.
lines.zh: 她把艾希琳的盾與劍立在井口，留了下來。不是封印，也不是祭品，而是一個活著的守望者。

lines.en: She stood not against what lay below, but against those who would go down. And upon old parchment, she set down all that she had seen.
lines.zh: 她擋的不是井底的東西，而是想往下走的人。她把一路看到的一切，畫在舊紙上。

lines.en: Many winters after, her red hair gone to grey, a child leaned over the Well — and from far below came the faintest whisper.
lines.zh: 很多年後，她的紅髮已經灰白。一個孩子趴在井邊往下看，底下傳來很輕的一聲低語。

lines.en: She drew the child away. "The Well still remembereth. But it shall not take our children anymore."
lines.zh: 她把孩子拉回來：「井還記得。但它再也不會帶走我們的孩子。」
